content:
In the Lean source code I'm hunting around for the code that runs when Lean elaborates an identifier - I'd like to see exactly how it works its magic.

Unfortunately I haven't found this code yet. If I could find the syntax declaration that says that an identifier is a term, presumably that will have a name that will lead to the elaborator. But I haven't found that syntax declaration either. Any pointers?
Aah, there it is, and with a name that is perfectly sensible. Thanks!
